extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: cruising sailboat (sloop), approx. 9.0 x 3.0 x 13.2 m (L x W x H incl. mast), draft 1.55 m, mast 10.4 m above deck
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; stands on its keel bulb at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 1.55 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: sailboat_rudder (turns around Z), sailboat_helm_wheel (turns around its shaft), sailboat_boom_mainsail (boom + mainsail swing around the mast axis Z); sails are solid cambered shells with thickness; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text, no sail number

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
